title: Deeper/broader peer capability grades and AcDs validation gate
scope: Open-source DWG/DXF peer capability and maturity terminology
Operation-specific data loss in cross-document copy and rendering routes
FreeCAD converter/importer boundary for ACIS-bearing DWG/DXF
Generated AcDs direct/blob threshold and Blob01 page-chain test readiness

sources.name: LibreDWG manual: class stability and test coverage
sources.evidence: The manual separates stable, unstable, debugging and unhandled classes, and separately lists enabled-but-untested and no-test-coverage classes. These are distinct source/documentation statuses, not a pinned executable result.

sources.name: ezdxf xref documentation
sources.evidence: The cross-document import/copy route lists ACAD_TABLE and preserved unknown/proxy tag storage as unsupported and documents silent omission without an exception. The scope is xref/copy, not ordinary file parsing or same-document save.

sources.name: ezdxf drawing add-on limitations
sources.evidence: The drawing add-on documents no ACIS rendering and no 3D rendering engine; 3D entities are projected into the XY plane.

sources.name: FreeCAD import/export limits
sources.evidence: The manual describes FreeCAD DXF import/export as 2D for proprietary ACIS 3D data, with DWG subject to the same importer limitation.

sources.name: FreeCAD additional importer/converter components
sources.evidence: The docs distinguish the native C++ DXF importer from an optional legacy Python importer and describe DWG conversion through external tools.

sources.name: FreeCAD current DWG importer source
sources.evidence: The application route delegates DWG conversion and then opens the produced DXF through the configured importer; this is a composed converter/importer route, not a direct DWG 3D parser result.

assessment.peer_comparison_rule: Grade each artifact by exact revision, operation, target version, record identity/owner disposition, carrier versus projection, and downstream semantic route; do not treat a project-level support label, exit code, preview, or missing test coverage as universal capability evidence.
assessment.independence_rule: Record parser and kernel lineage separately; wrappers, forks and applications sharing a parser/kernel are not independent votes.
assessment.support_claim_effect: No peer claim promotes local DXF/DWG, ACIS, AcDs, native-consumer, or external-only support status.
